Advertisement for the post of project Scientist-D (Project Research Scientist – III)
Applications are invited from eligible candidates for the following temporary posts in the
Research Project entitled "Economic Analysis of Air Pollution Mitigation Strategies in
India" The post is purely on contract basis and co-terminus with the project term.
Post: Project Scientist D (Project Research Scientist – III)
Qualification:
Essential Qualifications:
• First Class Post Graduate Degree in Environment Engineering/ Environment Science/Atmospheric
Sciences/ allied discipline, including the integrated PG degrees from a recognized institution/
University, with 3 years of relevant research experience in air quality modeling and emission
inventory development or PhD with specialisation in air quality research
Or
• Second Class Post Graduate Degree in Environment Engineering/ Environment
Science/Atmospheric Sciences/ allied discipline, including the integrated PG degrees from a
recognized institution/ University, with PhD in air quality research and 3 years of relevant research
experience in air quality modeling and emission inventory development
Or
• Must have handled minimum five Projects relevant to the requirement, as Principal Investigator or
Co-Pl
Or
• For Engineering - First Class Graduate degree of Four Years in Environment Engineering/
/Atmospheric Sciences/ allied discipline with Five years Experience experience in air quality
modeling and emission inventory development
Desirable:
a) Technical Expertise:
• Demonstrated experience in emission inventory development using both Top-Down and
Bottom-Up approaches
• Proficiency in air dispersion modeling software (AERMOD, CALPUFF, WRF-Chem)
• Experience with GIS software (ArcGIS/QGIS) for spatial analysis and gridded emission
mapping
• Programming skills in Python/R/MATLAB for data analysis and model development
• Knowledge of satellite data processing for air quality applications
b) Research Experience:
• Published research papers in SCI/SCIE journals on air quality modeling, emission
inventory, or related topics
• Experience in source apportionment studies and receptor modeling
• Familiarity with CPCB emission inventory guidelines and USEPA AP-42 methodology
• Experience in policy analysis and regulatory impact assessment
c) Project Management:
• Experience in leading research teams and managing multi-institutional collaborations
Department of Environment Studies
Panjab University, Chandigarh (INDIA)
Dr Suman Mor
Professor & Principal Investigator E. Mail: sumanmor@pu.ac.in
• Grant writing and project proposal development experience
• Experience in stakeholder engagement and policy communication
Salary: Rs. 92,040/- per month (fixed)
Maximum Age Limit in years: 45 years
Candidate should be available for immediate joining, if selected
Job Description:
• Lead the development of high-resolution multi-source gridded emissions for 3-7
selected Indian cities
• Design and implement methodology for link-level traffic emission estimation including
exhaust and non-exhaust emissions
• Conduct regulatory policy assessment and quantify emission reduction scenarios
• Supervise PM2.5 concentration modeling using AERMOD and validate model outputs
• Coordinate with team members for primary data collection and secondary data
compilation
• Prepare technical reports, research publications, and policy briefs
• Present findings to stakeholders and participate in project review meetings
Hardcopy of Applications along with bio-data and attested copies of certificates and work
experience etc should reach to the undersigned latest by 03 September 2025 before 2.00 pm in
room no 227, Department of Environment Studies, Panjab University Chandigarh. The
application form can be downloaded from Panjab University jobs website link
(https://jobs.puchd.ac.in/list-jobs.php). Only submitted hardcopy will be considered and no
application via email will be considered.
Candidate should also fill the google form https://forms.gle/1FBnCa6yUsHtGn5b9
before submitting application with document in the office The interview date and time will be
informed through email to shortlisted candidates. No TA/DA will be paid to attend the
interview. The rules and regulations as laid down by Panjab University and/or funding agency
will govern the selected candidate.
(Dr Suman Mor)
